title: Execution of a template program
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine, let $x$ be a binary input, let $\theta$ be a template, let $\rho$ be a valuation of the eleven registers, and let $p\in\mathbb N$ be the input position. Starting at the program label for $\theta$, the counter program reaches the label following $\theta$, with registers $\rho$ and input position $p$ unchanged, and appends the output produced by executing the template's operations with register values $\rho$. This execution takes at most the number of operations in the template plus one steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$\theta$ is a template for the machine's work tapes
$\rho$ assigns a natural-number value to each of eleven registers
